The role ensures correct ticket priority, categorization, handler assignment, action planning, follow-up, and progress in line with agreed priorities. The role supports MIS ticket processing through DMS synergy by ensuring required technical documentation is available, consulted, and accurately reflected in ticket handling, AMOS updates, validation, and related maintenance support activities. A key part of the role is data-driven coordination. The job holder is expected to have strong data analytical skills to analyze ticket and project data, cross-reference information against AMOS data, identify required updates, prepare clear reports, and recommend practical next steps. The successful candidate will act as a trusted partner to management and employees. Manage end-to-end recruitment and talent acquisition strategies to attract qualified candidates through job platforms, LinkedIn, referrals, and other sourcing channels. Improve employee experience by supporting engagement programs, workplace communication, employee feedback, and retention initiatives. Partner with department heads and managers to understand staffing needs, employee concerns, and organizational goals. Guide managers and employees on HR policies, workplace concerns, disciplinary actions, grievance handling, and conflict resolution. Ensure accurate and timely administration of compensation, benefits, government-mandated benefits, employee records, and HR documentation. Plan and implement training and development programs to improve employee skills, leadership capability, and work performance.
